mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 6.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE > 6.5% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) for two consecutive months indicate broad economic weakness, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS and INDPRO both decline for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year) triggers Federal Reserve tightening, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months signals strengthening manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO increases for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 950,000 units for two consecutive months indicates weakening housing market conditions, reducing consumer confidence and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 950.0 (thousands of units) for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST < 950.0 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle labor markets (UNRATE < 5.0%), a sharp decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) signals an impending economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE < 5.0% and PAYEMS declines for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and retail sales (RSAFS) for two consecutive months indicate severe economic contraction, triggering immediate earnings pressure and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO and RSAFS both decline for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.
